desc:
Ptumwan ✖ Utenthawai - Who is the real lord of this land? 😤

👊 Combination of punches, kicks, and strikes to knock down and then hit again. 
🤕 Got hit so hard that I passed out. My friends had to press E to support me, otherwise I would have died. 
🏬 Seize the MBK mall, display the institute's flag, and receive protection value every 30 seconds. 
💰 Earn money: Sell collectibles, get delivery jobs, earn a salary, or win prizes. 
🔫 Gun shop, real gun sounds 
🏍️ Ride motorcycles around the city + Electric cars 
👕 Over 20 different student uniforms from various institutions 
📱 Playable on mobile devices, large buttons, easy to hit/shoot. 

How to play
• Click/Tap = Attack (Press and hold = combo)

• Run and hit = kick away
• Falling, press/tap repeatedly = get up quickly.
• Friend is unconscious. Walk and press E repeatedly = Support.

This game is just for entertainment.
